this_delta.purpose: Freeze shared German comparator scoring semantics before the already-routed target-quality measurement so model ranking cannot depend on hidden evaluator normalization or censored VAD rejects.

new_measurement_invariants: Persist both FLEURS raw_transcription and transcription plus raw model hypotheses.
Use one hashed evaluator normalizer identically across every speech arm.
Preserve German letters/diacritics/sharp-s in the primary evaluator.
A gated speech rejection stays in WER/CER as an empty hypothesis and is also a gate false reject.
Non-speech false activation is measured separately from speech WER/CER.
Raw-decoder and gated-pipeline quality/latency remain separate.
If an explicit diagnostic normalizer changes material candidate ordering, mark the result normalization-sensitive.
